_comment: English body for prompt-case-literature-screen. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Output a screening table with reasons; use titles/abstracts only and do not invent full-text conclusions.
Inputs: Titles/abstracts, inclusion criteria, and exclusion criteria.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Screen literature by criteria. Output decisions[] with id, decision (include/exclude/uncertain), criterion and quote. quote comes from title/abstract; uncertain must state missing information. Do not conclude from full text that was not provided.
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.预期输出形态: decisions[] with criteria and verbatim basis.
sections.检查点:
- Each decision has a criterion.
- Quotes appear in title/abstract.
- Uncertain items state missing information.
sections.失败分支:
- Vague criteria: write decidable conditions first.
- Abstract insufficient: mark uncertain pending full text.
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.
